build_FairseqNATModel: build a nonautoregressive translation model using FairseqNATModel with a custom encoder and decoder
build_FairseqNATEncoder: build a FairseqNATEncoder instance with args, source dictionary, and embedded tokens
build_FairseqNATDecoder: build a FairseqNATDecoder instance with args, target dictionary, and embedded tokens
enable_ensemble_FairseqNATModel: enable ensemble inference on a FairseqNATModel by passing a list of model instances
review_ensemble_encoder_decoder: review the ensemble_encoder and ensemble_decoder decorators that stack outputs from multiple models
